title: Privacy and evidence disclosure projections v1
description: Which field reaches which audience, as data rather than as a property of whichever response shape happened to be written first. docs/privacy/PRIVACY_CONTRACT.md and docs/product/PRODUCT_SPEC.md are the normative owners; the fields themselves live on the response schemas in packages/schemas/openapi-v1.yaml, and the validator fails when a field named here does not exist there. D-226 recorded that the projection was being carried by the difference between two response shapes and that the separate record PF-046 names had not been authored; this is it. The rule it exists to make checkable is D-144: a public surface publishes credited_token_burn and never token_burn_total, because the two together yield the confidence weight by division and, since evidence_class is already public, yield the trust factor and therefore the sanction D-084 keeps private. No client invents any of this.

audiences.description: Ordered from narrowest to widest. A field disclosed to a wider audience than another is disclosed to every narrower one, and the validator checks that monotonicity rather than trusting it.

api_schema.description: A schema name under components/schemas in packages/schemas/openapi-v1.yaml.

audience.description: The widest audience this shape is ever served to. No field on it may be narrower than that, because a narrower field on a wider shape is a redaction the server has to perform per response — and a redaction that fails open publishes the field. Narrowing is expressed by putting the field on a different shape, which is why SelfRankEntry exists.

classification.description: derived fields are not portable under Article 20 and remain accessible under Article 15, which D-108 fixes on the WP242 rev.01 observed-versus-derived line. server-assigned fields are never selected by a client, which is the same rule that makes public evidence status the verifier's to award.

reason.description: Why this field stops where it does. Required on any field narrower than the shape that carries it, because a narrowing with no recorded reason is one nobody can re-examine.
